checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Output is a 1:1 square, same as the source.
Nothing is cropped, but only because nothing was changed.

must.item: Added background uses blurred source, no text
must.why: No background was added and there is no 9:16 canvas.

faults.what: The delivered image is still a square and was not reformatted to 9:16 Instagram story size, which was the whole request.
The assistant said it had made a vertical 9:16 picture with extra park added above and below. The output contradicts that claim.

summary: The output is the original square photo, not a 9:16 story frame, so the core request failed and the assistant's description of the result was wrong.
